answer: Each identity files a notarized affidavit: a licensed notary witnesses the signer in person and files its hash in the Lotus Registry, with a 20 POA bond locked 120 days. Bonds double per extra affidavit in one cluster (20, doubling to a 640 POA cap), plus a 15 POA fee each, so 100 fakes cost 62,920 POA against 35 POA honest. Each epoch the notary must answer a whisper check within 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs. The Atlas of licensed notaries caps each at 50 a month; a reused affidavit voids both bonds. Remote signers use a mobile notary and a doubled bond.
